authority.destructive_boundary: Only the marked dsh-remote Nginx configuration may be replaced through the managed backup-first apply workflow and restored through its exact receipt; unrelated VPS state must not change.

intent.goal: Reduce dsh-remote request latency by preserving HTTP upstream connections across the existing SSH reverse tunnel, deploy the reversible edge update, and remeasure the complete path without changing remote access behavior.
non_goals: Changing authentication, private-link, session rotation, or WebSocket semantics
Changing VPS provider, DNS, certificate, firewall, or public listener topology
Persisting DSH data on the VPS
Introducing a public reverse-tunnel TCP port

acceptance: US-R1 remains complete for authenticated HTTP, refresh, root-relative resources, APIs, and WebSocket traffic.
Ordinary HTTP requests no longer force Connection: close between Nginx and the local gateway.
The local gateway preserves idle upstream connections long enough for normal remote interaction.
Post-deployment repeated tunnel and public requests show lower warm-request latency than the recorded cold baseline without availability regression.
final_evidence: Focused gateway and VPS configuration tests
Managed VPS preflight, apply receipt, and ready status
Repeated local, Unix-socket tunnel, and public HTTPS timing samples
outcome.first_evidence: Measured local gateway latency below 2ms, local-to-VPS RTT near 365ms, independent tunneled request latency of 0.67-1.13s, and reusable tunneled HTTP latency near 0.18-0.19s.

recovery.failure_strategy: Stop on failed tests or preflight; managed apply automatically restores on validation failure; after an observable regression, roll back the newest exact receipt and verify ready status.
recovery.maintenance_window: One managed Nginx container recreation after local verification; existing SSH tunnel and DSH process remain running.
recovery.restore_point: Git commit fa67a38ca8d349d2e4c1d488c57ae8d2565548b7 plus the exact VPS receipt created immediately before the performance apply.

integration_subjects: dsh-remote repository commit and deployed zsh.onlyservice.io edge revision
